name: Stuibenfälle im Außerfern
kurzbeschreibung: The romantic Stuibenfälle at the foot of the Zugspitze are impressive waterfall cascades, surrounded by dense mountain forest.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Stuibenfälle waterfalls in the Außerfern region form a wildly romantic, cascading natural spectacle stretching between Breitenwang near Reutte and the outflow of Lake Plansee. Channeled from the crystalline alpine reservoir of Plansee, the untamed Archbach torrent plunges nearly 150 vertical meters over jagged limestone shelves and foam-crested rapids through a deeply shaded canyon. The local term "Stuiben" derives from the alpine vernacular for dusting or spraying mist, perfectly describing the shimmering water clouds that cast dazzling rainbows over the gorge in sunny weather. Tracing the cataracts is the historic Ministersteig—an engineered trail sculpted into vertical limestone cliffs during the 19th century—which remains one of the premier canyon walks in the Reutte basin.

Route & Requirements

The trek through the Stuibenfälle begins ideally at the hydroelectric power station in Breitenwang or near the Kanzelkehre bend on the Plansee road. Spanning roughly four kilometers, the signposted trail gains 160 vertical meters up to the scenic pond of Kleiner Plansee and the main lake (walking time 1.5 to 2 hours uphill, moderate grade T2). Navigating secured timber walkways, stone staircases, tree-root paths, and scenic footbridges, hikers alternate between cool pine-beech forest and cantilevered viewing platforms perched directly over thunderous rock pools. The deeply gouged river potholes and turquoise water basins also serve as a premier playground for guided canyoning excursions. Because continuous spray keeps rock steps and wooden planks damp, sturdy hiking boots with aggressive non-slip tread are strictly required. Due to numerous stairs, the gorge is impassable for strollers. Leashed, surefooted dogs are welcome.

Visit & Arrival

Rail travelers arrive via the Außerfernbahn railway at Reutte in Tirol station. From the terminal forecourt, regional VVT bus lines 150 or 154 travel toward Plansee, stopping at Breitenwang or the Stuibenfälle road junction. Motorists follow federal highway B179 into Reutte/Breitenwang and take provincial road L255 toward Plansee. Dedicated hiker parking is situated beside the power utility gates and at the Kanzelkehre pullout.

Tips

Extend your gorge walk by circling the serene Kleiner Plansee tarn and continuing along the shore of main Lake Plansee, where fresh fish awaits at Hotel Forelle or artisanal cheese at Musteralpe. Pack a light windbreaker or rain shell to protect against the refreshing, aerosol-rich canyon mist.
saison: Mai bis Oktober (im Winter vereist und gesperrt)
